CustomMosque.title: CustomMosque
CustomMosque.description: User-contributed mosque or musholla record not yet mapped in OpenStreetMap.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who added this mosque.

name.description: Official or commonly known name of the mosque or musholla.

baseFacilities.description: List of facility IDs confirmed when adding the mosque.

visibility.description: Public directory marker aligned with Firestore list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MosqueReview.title: MosqueReview
MosqueReview.description: User rating, facility verification checklist, and review notes for a visited mosque.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reviewer.

mosqueId.description: Identifier of the reviewed mosque (OSM or custom mosque ID).

rating.description: Overall hospitality and facility rating from 1 to 5.

facilities.description: List of facility IDs confirmed by the reviewer during their visit.

comment.description: Traveler review notes on cleanliness, overnight rules, drinks, or WiFi.

visibility.description: Public review marker aligned with Firestore list queries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FavoriteMosque.title: FavoriteMosque
FavoriteMosque.description: A user's bookmarked favorite mosque for quick traveler access.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

address.description: Address or landmark of the bookmarked mosque.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when bookmarked (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/custom_mosques/{mosqueId}.description: Community-contributed mosques readable by signed-in users and editable only by their creator.

/mosque_reviews/{reviewId}.description: Community mosque facility reviews readable by signed-in users and editable/deletable only by their author.
